verdict.rationale: Activepieces flows start from a trigger that fires when something happens, which suggests an event-driven subscription model (docs-21, docs-39). However, the evidence never mentions webhooks, whether as a webhook trigger or as outbound webhook subscriptions to platform events. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook triggers or webhook endpoints, documented outbound event subscriptions (event types, payloads, signing, retries), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
